D/ OFFA / REX ; R/ JEL / VALP EðEL / UALD

Silver Coin. Penny of Offa of Mercia (757-796), possibly London or Canterbury light issue of 780-792. Obverse description: Beaded shaft with a cross at either end, separating horizontal legend. Three pellets scattered in upper field, two separate and three grouped pellets in lower field. Obverse inscription: OFFA / REX [King Offa of Mercia].
